|rulings=* If some or all characters fail to move away, the battle will still be canceled.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Fall%20Back%21 Scomp: Fall Back!]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). * Close The Blast Doors! will cause Light to lose 1 Force for each character that moves away, and then also lose 1 Force for canceling the battle.
* Characters inside open vehicles will automatically disembark to move away. Characters inside starships and enclosed vehicles are not present and so do not move away.
